minutes.headline: Select Board ratified a new finance director/town accountant, opposed HR 3557, and heard Lake Shirley parcel transfer; vote set for February
minutes.summary: The board ratified the town manager's appointment of a finance director and town accountant and approved his contract, then voted to send a letter opposing federal bill HR 3557 on behalf of public access TV funding. Most of the night was a long hearing on transferring two town parcels on Lake Shirley to the Parks Commission, with strong neighbor opposition; no vote was taken and a site walk was proposed. The town manager also presented the FY25 capital plan, goals update, and ARPA grant agreement.

what_happened.line: The Select Board ratified the town manager's appointment of a finance director and appointed a town accountant, then approved the contract, both by roll call.
The board voted by roll call to send a letter opposing federal bill HR 3557, which concerns funding for public access TV.
A long hearing on transferring two town parcels on Lake Shirley to the Parks Commission drew strong opposition from neighbors; no vote was taken.
The parcel transfer vote was set for the first meeting in February, and Parks Commissioners were asked to arrange a site walk and a written preliminary vision.
The town manager presented the FY25 capital plan as information only; the board also approved a historical commission grant application.

why_it_matters: The Lake Shirley parcels may change from town-held land to Parks Commission land with public access, and residents will be asked to weigh in before the February vote.
The FY25 capital requests are ranked by priority, and the items that are funded will show up in a future budget and tax bill.
watch_next: Select Board vote on the Lake Shirley parcel transfer, set for the first meeting of February.
A site walk with Lake Shirley and open space representatives, and the written preliminary vision the Parks Commissioners were asked to prepare.

reconciliation.summary: The four votes agree in subject and outcome (passed, 4-0-0 officially), and most capital figures agree once caption garbling is read past. The one real conflict is the February 6 to January 30 meeting swap: ours says it was only possible and to be confirmed, while the official minutes say the Board agreed to it.
